shapeSummary: 84 mm diameter, 24 mm wide polyurethane wheel with its axis along Z. The tread is rounded by an 8 mm fillet on both outer edges. A 22 mm through bore runs along the axis. The wheel is centered in X and Z, and its lowest point sits at Y=0, so the center is at Y=42.
warnings: The 84 mm diameter and 24 mm width come from the unverified product description.
The 22 mm bore is an assumption taken from the image analysis. It matches the outside diameter of a 608 bearing, so the real through-opening is probably smaller (about 8 mm).
The 8 mm tread fillet radius is estimated from the image.
The recessed hub faces, spoke webbing, central hub boss and adapter screw holes are not modeled because their dimensions are unknown.
The slight parting line at the tread center is not modeled.
